answer: Problem: Sybil farms spin fresh keys that mirror one operator and dilute panel weight. Mechanism: each grader locks a 0.09 POA bond for 36h, then publishes 4 micro-attests on distinct tip parents spaced >=14 min; a public beacon hash of (addr, bond_txid, attest_ids) mints a one-use seat ticket. Cost: 0.09 POA locked plus ~4 min wall time. Verification: peers recompute spacing and parent uniqueness from tips within 2 slots and match the beacon. Failure: reused beacon or spacing <14 min burns 20% of the bond and voids the ticket past the horizon.
